packages.doc:
Package candidate provides immutable candidate identity definitions, artifact
manifest specifications, and pure in-memory validation routines.

Stability: Experimental / Provisional for APGR v0.12 (ICR-004 / ICR-005).
Exported candidate contracts are candidate surfaces for JACA XO evaluation.
Transition to Supported status occurs upon production qualification in v1.0.

Authority Boundary:
This package owns data models and pure validation only. Repository mutation,
Git commit creation, publication, and workspace custody remain behind caller-owned
authority implementations (e.g. JACA repository mutation fence).

Concurrency and Immutability:
All types and values in this package are immutable once constructed and safe
for concurrent access across goroutines.

types.name: Artifact
types.doc: Artifact describes a single immutable evidence file emitted during phase execution.
types.def:
struct {
	ArtifactID   string `json:"artifact_id"`
	RunID        string `json:"run_id"`
	PhaseID      string `json:"phase_id"`
	RelativePath string `json:"relative_path"`
	MediaType    string `json:"media_type"`
	ByteSize     int64  `json:"byte_size"`
	SHA256       string `json:"sha256"`
}

types.name: ArtifactManifest
types.doc: ArtifactManifest lists all artifacts emitted by a single phase run.

types.name: CandidateIdentity
types.doc: CandidateIdentity represents an immutable proposed workspace state produced by a mutating role.
types.def:
struct {
	CandidateID       string  `json:"candidate_id"`
	Generation        int     `json:"generation"`
	ProducerRole      string  `json:"producer_role"`
	ProducerAttemptID string  `json:"producer_attempt_id"`
	PredecessorID     *string `json:"predecessor_id,omitempty"`
	Commit            string  `json:"commit,omitempty"`
	TreeDigest        string  `json:"tree_digest,omitempty"`
	ExpectedBase      string  `json:"expected_base,omitempty"`
}

functions.name: ValidateArtifact
functions.doc: ValidateArtifact verifies path safety, non-negative size, and SHA-256 formatting.

functions.name: ValidateCandidate
functions.doc: ValidateCandidate validates structural invariants on CandidateIdentity.

functions.name: ValidateManifest
functions.doc: ValidateManifest validates all artifacts in the manifest.

packages.doc:
Package evidence defines structured models for review findings, severities,
categories, dispositions, review bindings, and completion receipts.

Stability: Experimental / Provisional for APGR v0.12 (ICR-004 / ICR-005).
Exported evidence types are candidate surfaces for JACA XO evaluation. Transition
to Supported status occurs upon production qualification in v1.0.

Security & Path Safety:
Review findings strictly reject path traversal tokens ("..", leading slashes,
or non-normalized forms) to protect consumer systems from path leakage or tampering.

Concurrency and Immutability:
All types and values in this package are immutable once constructed and safe
for concurrent access across goroutines.

types.name: BasisType
types.doc: BasisType represents the authoritative rationale basis for the disposition.
types.def: string

types.name: CompletionReceipt
types.doc: CompletionReceipt represents a verifiable finalization receipt for a completed phase run.
types.def:
struct {
	ReceiptID      string `json:"receipt_id"`
	RunID          string `json:"run_id"`
	PhaseID        string `json:"phase_id"`
	CompletedAt    string `json:"completed_at"`
	TerminalStatus string `json:"terminal_status"`
	ArchiveSHA256  string `json:"archive_sha256"`
}

types.name: DispositionAction
types.doc: DispositionAction represents the disposition action taken on a review finding.
types.def: string

types.name: FindingCategory
types.doc: FindingCategory represents the domain category of a review finding.
types.def: string

types.name: FindingDisposition
types.doc: FindingDisposition records the single-source disposition of a review finding.

types.name: FindingSeverity
types.doc: FindingSeverity represents the severity level of a review finding.
types.def: string

types.name: ReviewBinding
types.doc: ReviewBinding links a review execution attempt with candidate identity, outcome, and findings.
types.def:
struct {
	ReviewID         string          `json:"review_id"`
	RunID            string          `json:"run_id"`
	CandidateID      string          `json:"candidate_id"`
	ReviewerProvider string          `json:"reviewer_provider"`
	ReviewerProfile  string          `json:"reviewer_profile"`
	Outcome          ReviewOutcome   `json:"outcome"`
	Findings         []ReviewFinding `json:"findings,omitempty"`
}

types.name: ReviewFinding
types.doc: ReviewFinding represents a structured finding reported by a Plan Reviewer or Work Reviewer.
types.def:
struct {
	FindingID string          `json:"finding_id"`
	Severity  FindingSeverity `json:"severity"`
	Category  FindingCategory `json:"category"`
	Summary   string          `json:"summary"`
	FilePath  string          `json:"file_path,omitempty"`
	LineStart int             `json:"line_start,omitempty"`
	LineEnd   int             `json:"line_end,omitempty"`
}

types.name: ReviewOutcome
types.doc: ReviewOutcome represents the result classification of a review attempt.
types.def: string

functions.name: ValidAction
functions.doc: ValidAction reports whether a is one of the four canonical disposition actions.

functions.name: ValidBasis
functions.doc: ValidBasis reports whether b is one of the four canonical basis types.

functions.name: ValidCategory
functions.doc: ValidCategory reports whether c is one of the six canonical finding categories.

functions.name: ValidReviewOutcome
functions.doc: ValidReviewOutcome reports whether o is one of the three canonical review outcomes.

functions.name: ValidSeverity
functions.doc: ValidSeverity reports whether s is one of the three canonical severities.

functions.name: ValidateDisposition
functions.doc: ValidateDisposition validates invariants on a FindingDisposition.

functions.name: ValidateFinding
functions.doc: ValidateFinding validates boundary invariants on a ReviewFinding.

functions.name: ValidateReceipt
functions.doc: ValidateReceipt checks structural validity and SHA-256 formatting of a CompletionReceipt.

functions.name: ValidateReviewBinding
functions.doc: ValidateReviewBinding validates structural consistency of a ReviewBinding.

packages.doc:
Package phase provides reusable, deterministic domain contracts for single-phase
lifecycles, work-only Request V2 parsing, semantic responsibility definitions,
actor binding topologies, and invocation attempt models.

Stability: Experimental / Provisional for APGR v0.12 (ICR-004 / ICR-005).
Exported domain types are candidate surfaces for JACA XO evaluation. Transition
to Supported status occurs upon production qualification in v1.0.

Request V2 enforces a strict work-only schema: schema, phase_type, and prompt.
Runtime policy fields such as execution_mode, constraints, provider, model, or
profile are strictly rejected at parse time.

Concurrency and Immutability:
All types and values in this package are immutable once constructed and safe
for concurrent access across goroutines.

types.name: ActorBinding
types.doc:
ActorBinding groups one or more semantic responsibilities into an invocation turn.
This decouples the 8 invariant roles from execution topologies (ADR 0059 / ADR 0064).
types.def:
struct {
	BindingID            string         `json:"binding_id"`
	Roles                []SemanticRole `json:"roles"`
	PolicyName           string         `json:"policy_name"`
	IsMutating           bool           `json:"is_mutating"`
	ProcessReadOnly      bool           `json:"process_read_only"`
	RequiredCapabilities []string       `json:"required_capabilities"`
}

types.name: AttemptStatus
types.doc: AttemptStatus represents the lifecycle state of an invocation attempt.
types.def: string

types.name: FailureCategory
types.doc: FailureCategory classifies phase-level failures for deterministic recovery.
types.def: string

types.name: InvocationAttempt
types.doc: InvocationAttempt records a single provider invocation attempt for an actor binding turn.
types.def:
struct {
	AttemptID     string        `json:"attempt_id"`
	BindingID     string        `json:"binding_id"`
	PredecessorID *string       `json:"predecessor_id,omitempty"`
	Status        AttemptStatus `json:"status"`
	StartedAt     string        `json:"started_at"`
	CompletedAt   *string       `json:"completed_at,omitempty"`
	ExitCode      *int          `json:"exit_code,omitempty"`
}

types.name: RequestV2
types.doc:
RequestV2 represents a validated, work-only single-phase request envelope.
In accordance with ADR 0058 and ADR 0066, Request V2 contains no runtime routing
or execution mode fields; policy remains external to the task contract.

types.name: SemanticRole
types.doc: SemanticRole represents one of the 8 canonical semantic responsibilities (ADR 0059).
types.def: string

types.name: TerminalStatus
types.doc: TerminalStatus represents the final outcome of an executed phase.
types.def: string

functions.name: BuildRouteRequirements
functions.doc:
BuildRouteRequirements maps an APGR ActorBinding and prior resolutions into policy-neutral
RouteRequirements consumed by routing.Resolve.

functions.name: DefaultBindings
functions.doc: DefaultBindings returns the standard 5-turn topology merging adjacent responsibilities.

functions.name: IsMutating
functions.doc: IsMutating reports whether the role is authorized to perform repository mutations.

functions.name: IsReadOnly
functions.doc: IsReadOnly reports whether the role is strictly read-only by process invariant.

functions.name: MustNewActorBinding
functions.doc: MustNewActorBinding is a helper that panics if NewActorBinding fails (for static topologies).
functions.signature: func(bindingID string, roles []SemanticRole, policyName string) ActorBinding

functions.name: NewActorBinding
functions.doc:
NewActorBinding constructs a validated ActorBinding, automatically computing
the required capability union, mutating flag, and read-only status.
functions.signature: func(bindingID string, roles []SemanticRole, policyName string) (ActorBinding, error)

functions.name: ParseRequestV2
functions.doc:
ParseRequestV2 parses and strictly validates raw JSON bytes as RequestV2.
Any unknown or prohibited fields (e.g. execution_mode, constraints) fail closed.

functions.name: RequiredCapabilities
functions.doc: RequiredCapabilities returns the minimal capability strings required for the role.

functions.name: ResolveActorBindingRoute
functions.doc: ResolveActorBindingRoute is a convenience helper that builds route requirements and calls routing.Resolve.
functions.signature:
func(
	ctx context.Context,
	binding ActorBinding,
	phaseType string,
	catalog map[string]routing.EndpointCapabilities,
	observations []routing.OperationalObservation,
	priorResolutions map[string]routing.ResolvedActorRoute,
	now float64,
) (*routing.ResolvedActorRoute, error)

functions.name: UnmergedBindings
functions.doc: UnmergedBindings returns the discrete 8-turn topology where each role maps to one binding.

functions.name: ValidPhaseType
functions.doc: ValidPhaseType returns true if phaseType is one of the supported APGR phase types.

functions.name: ValidRole
functions.doc: ValidRole reports whether r is one of the 8 canonical semantic responsibilities.

functions.name: ValidateRequestV2
functions.doc: ValidateRequestV2 checks domain invariants on an existing RequestV2 struct.

packages.doc:
Package provider defines machine-readable capability and conformance row types
representing evaluated features across the Codex, Claude, and Antigravity provider
families (ADR 0061 / ADR 0065).

Stability: Experimental / Provisional for APGR v0.12 (ICR-004 / ICR-005).
Exported conformance types are candidate surfaces for JACA XO evaluation.
Transition to Supported status occurs upon production qualification in v1.0.

Concurrency and Immutability:
All types and values in this package are immutable once constructed and safe
for concurrent access across goroutines.

types.name: ConformanceMatrix
types.doc: ConformanceMatrix represents the complete 22-row capability evaluation matrix.

types.name: ConformanceRow
types.doc: ConformanceRow represents one evaluated provider capability dimension.

types.name: ProviderFamily
types.doc: ProviderFamily identifies one of the three first-class supported provider families.
types.def: string

types.name: SupportStatus
types.doc: SupportStatus records whether a capability is supported and any operational notes.

functions.name: LoadConformanceMatrix
functions.doc: LoadConformanceMatrix unmarshals and validates a conformance matrix JSON payload.

functions.name: ValidateMatrix
functions.doc: ValidateMatrix verifies all 22 required rows are present with evaluations for all 3 families.

packages.doc:
Package routing provides pure, deterministic route eligibility, ranking,
tie-breaking evaluation, and operational observation models.

Stability: Experimental / Provisional for APGR v0.12 (ICR-004 / ICR-005).
Exported resolver primitives and observation types are candidate surfaces for
JACA XO evaluation. Transition to Supported status occurs upon production qualification.

Policy Neutrality & Non-Authority Contract:
The resolver in this package is an unprivileged, pure in-memory calculation engine.
It accepts caller-supplied capability catalogs, observations, and requirement structs.
Exporting or invoking routing.Resolve transfers NO route-policy authority to APGR.
When consumed by JACA XO or external orchestrators, JACA retains complete policy,
selection, and accounting authority over route decisions.

Environment Invariants:
This package contains zero subprocess execution, zero filesystem access, zero SQLite
persistence, and zero reliance on ambient working directory or environment variables.

Concurrency:
All exported structures, observation digests, and resolver functions are safe for
concurrent use by multiple goroutines.

types.name: EndpointCapabilities
types.doc: EndpointCapabilities describes the capabilities and posture of an endpoint.
types.def:
struct {
	EndpointAlias string   `json:"endpoint_alias"`
	Provider      string   `json:"provider"`
	Profile       string   `json:"profile"`
	Capabilities  []string `json:"capabilities"`
	Posture       string   `json:"posture"`
}

methods.name: IsMutating
methods.doc: IsMutating reports whether the endpoint posture allows repository mutations.

methods.name: IsReadOnly
methods.doc: IsReadOnly reports whether the endpoint posture is strictly read-only.

methods.name: Satisfies
methods.doc: Satisfies reports whether ep provides all required capabilities and satisfies posture bounds.

types.name: EndpointIdentity
types.doc: EndpointIdentity identifies a provider execution endpoint.

types.name: OperationalObservation
types.doc: OperationalObservation represents an observed provider availability, auth, quota, or cooldown record.
types.def:
struct {
	ObservationID   string         `json:"observation_id"`
	Producer        string         `json:"producer"`
	ObservationType string         `json:"observation_type"`
	Provider        string         `json:"provider"`
	Profile         *string        `json:"profile,omitempty"`
	Timestamp       float64        `json:"timestamp"`
	ExpiresAt       *float64       `json:"expires_at,omitempty"`
	StateValue      string         `json:"state_value"`
	Detail          map[string]any `json:"detail,omitempty"`
	Digest          string         `json:"digest,omitempty"`
}

methods.name: IsActive
methods.doc: IsActive reports whether the observation is currently active relative to the given timestamp.

types.name: ResolveRequest
types.doc: ResolveRequest wraps all in-memory inputs required to resolve a route deterministically.
types.def:
struct {
	Requirements        RouteRequirements               `json:"requirements"`
	BindingID           string                          `json:"binding_id"`
	Roles               []string                        `json:"roles,omitempty"`
	CapabilitiesCatalog map[string]EndpointCapabilities `json:"capabilities_catalog"`
	Observations        []OperationalObservation        `json:"observations,omitempty"`
	Now                 float64                         `json:"now"`
}

types.name: ResolvedActorRoute
types.doc: ResolvedActorRoute represents a selected endpoint and its provenance.
types.def:
struct {
	BindingID          string   `json:"binding_id"`
	Provider           string   `json:"provider"`
	Profile            string   `json:"profile"`
	EndpointAlias      string   `json:"endpoint_alias"`
	Capabilities       []string `json:"capabilities"`
	SelectionRationale string   `json:"selection_rationale"`
	Roles              []string `json:"roles,omitempty"`
	ObservationIDs     []string `json:"observation_ids,omitempty"`
}

types.name: RouteRequirements
types.doc: RouteRequirements holds the policy-neutral requirements for resolving a route.
types.def:
struct {
	PhaseType            string   `json:"phase_type"`
	RequiredCapabilities []string `json:"required_capabilities"`
	RequiresMutating     bool     `json:"requires_mutating"`
	IsReviewTurn         bool     `json:"is_review_turn"`
	IsProducerTurn       bool     `json:"is_producer_turn"`
	DistinctProviders    []string `json:"distinct_providers,omitempty"`
}

functions.name: CanonicalDigest
functions.doc:
CanonicalDigest computes the deterministic SHA-256 digest over the compact,
key-sorted JSON representation matching the APGR Python runtime oracle.

functions.name: Resolve
functions.doc:
Resolve executes the pure, deterministic 6-stage decision ladder.
It performs no filesystem, subprocess, or database operations.
